policy.primary: Same original station/location, UTC windows, components and physical units; no fitted amplitude renormalization
policy.spectral_quantity: One-sided multitaper acceleration PSD; displacement-equivalent ASD = sqrt(PSD)/(2*pi*f)^2
policy.response: Remove full dated response to ACC; water_level=None; pre_filt [.005,.02,25,40] Hz at 100 sps; scale high corners if needed

windows.short: S-.1 to S+10.0 s; equal 10.1 s pre-P noise ending P-1
windows.long: origin to origin+80 s; equal 80 s pre-P noise ending P-1

policy.multitaper: DPSS: short NW=3 K=5; long NW=2 K=3; unit-energy tapers, equal weights; next_fast_len FFT
policy.signal_quality: Amplitude SNR=sqrt(Psignal/Pnoise); common-signal ratio uses noise-subtracted power where both SNR>=3
policy.coherence: Component magnitude-squared coherence and its power-weighted mean; also retain phase-sensitive vector coherence; amplitude ratios use both SNR>=3 without requiring axis agreement
policy.timing: Original UTC timestamps; Lanczos interpolation onto common sample grid before spectral windows
policy.water_level_control: Output DISP, water_level 60 vs None, otherwise identical processing; this isolates regularization
policy.ML: Same 4--2 km/s hypocentral window, geometric horizontal WA peaks; causal .5--10 Hz; no water level; prefilter [.1,.25,15,20]
